text:
```yaml
name: AI Moderator

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  moderate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Run AI Moderator
        uses: github/ai-moderator@v1
        with:
          ai-model: "gpt-4o-mini"
          ai-model-version: "latest"
          ai-model-prompt: "moderate"
          minimize-comment: true
        env:
          AI_MODERATOR_SPAM_LABEL: "spam"
          AI_MODERATOR_AI_GENERATED_LABEL: "ai-generated"
```
